### Tables for the derivatives of the envelope {#sec:envelope-tables}

These tables belong to [[lem:envelope-derivatives]]. Throughout, β is the function of [[eq:envelope]], and β_n(m) :=
β^(n)(m)/n! is its n-th Taylor coefficient at the point m, given exactly by [[eq:taylor-beta]]. An entry written
±d.ddddddddde±kk denotes the decimal number ±d.ddddddddd × 10^(±kk). A coefficient entry is β_n(m) rounded to ten
significant digits, so it differs from β_n(m) by at most half a unit in its last digit; an entry 0 is exactly zero.
The bounds M, Γ_k, R_k and G_k are rounded up, ν_k and w_k down, each to four significant digits, and each is
evaluated with |β_n(m)| replaced by the absolute value of its entry plus half a unit in its last digit.

### The Taylor coefficients at the thirty nodes {#sec:envelope-table-nodes}

For each node m the row labelled n lists β_n(m), β_(n+1)(m), …, β_(n+5)(m); the last row lists β_30(m). The nodes
are the centres of the cells of [[sec:envelope-table-cells]] and the points m_k of [[sec:envelope-table-peaks]].

### The cells {#sec:envelope-table-cells}

Each entry gives the cell [y₋, y₊], its node m, the half-width h = max(m − y₋, y₊ − m), the radius ρ, the bound
M = M(m, ρ) of [[eq:cauchy-m]], and the bounds Γ_k of [[eq:cell-bound]] for k = 0, …, 14 (first line k = 0, …, 7,
second line k = 8, …, 14). A dash stands where the cell lies in the peak interval J_k of
[[sec:envelope-table-peaks]], on which [[lem:envelope-derivatives]] uses that interval instead. Every other entry
Γ_k is below the lower end S_k⁻ of [[sec:envelope-table-peaks]]; the largest ratio Γ_k/S_k⁻ is 0.988, for k = 14
on [0.175, 0.205].

### The peak intervals {#sec:envelope-table-peaks}

For each k the entry gives the node m_k, the half-width h_k and radius ρ_k, the bound M_k = M(m_k, ρ_k) of
[[eq:cauchy-m]], the values u_k = β^(k)(m_k), u′_k = β^(k+1)(m_k) and u″_k = β^(k+2)(m_k) (k!, (k+1)! and (k+2)!
times the entries of [[sec:envelope-table-nodes]]), the bound R_k of [[eq:peak-remainder]], ν_k := |u″_k| − R_k
rounded down (after the half units of u″_k are subtracted), G_k := |u″_k| + R_k rounded up, the number
w_k := |u_k| − |u′_k| h_k − h_k² G_k/2 rounded down, and the enclosure [S_k⁻, S_k⁺] of S_k = sup |β^(k)|, with
S_k⁻ = |u_k| rounded down after the half units of u_k are subtracted and S_k⁺ = |u_k| + u′_k²/(2ν_k) rounded up after
they are added. The peak interval is J_k := [m_k − h_k, m_k + h_k] ∩ [0, 1).
